description: February 21 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 21 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: The February 21 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Water settles in by February 21, with the Sun about two degrees into Pisces and Neptune ruling both the sign and its first decan. Twenty-one reduces to 3, so imagination finds a voice. Traditionally this birthday is associated with lyrical expression, whether music, poetry, painting or simply an unusually vivid way of describing an ordinary afternoon.

Astronomically, February 21 puts the Sun near 2° Pisces in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 21
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 21 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 21 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 21 is the 52nd day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aries, is usually complete within 29 days, by March 21.

By February 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a February 21 birthday are Corbin Bleu (1989), Robert Mugabe (1924) and Harald V of Norway (1937).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 21?
faq.answer: February 21 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 21 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 21?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 21?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 21 include Corbin Bleu (1989), Robert Mugabe (1924) and Harald V of Norway (1937). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
